content: Abun, ntɔn ilää kàpɛ Nzam mubilà u ngyöör ande kyà kapaa, wɛy bi ikäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn umwɛy uboo a bɛ ukɔ̈ɔ̈n asàkal u nsà.
Ntɔn bi sye, bi kàwɛl Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ asànaa ba. Wɛɛ ndaa bàwem ba yapɛ anki bweel, ntɔn umpal bàwem ba ya, ba bàsi anki làkwikilà amu ya.
Kyakin, bi baar kàsi làkwikilà, bi ibilà unsà ngyöör ayà kàtɛn nde naa:

content.text: « Uboo a nkyɛl amɛ, mɛ kadi kyän naa:
Ba bàsàbilà anki uboo a ngyöör amɛ! »

content: Nde kàtɛn abun, itàkal naa nde isal ande kàmay fà nkyeer a mɛɛn.
Ntɔn bàtɛn kà ikal mwɛy uboo a Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ntɔn ilä kyànsàmbwaar naa: « Nzam kàyöör kà ilä kyànsàmbwaar unsà isal ande byanswà. »
Unsà ya bàfàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa ba bàsàbilà anki u ngyöör amɛ! »
Yan'mɛnà ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa baar bumwɛy bàkyer abilà u ngyöör ayi. Kyeka, bàtàtwɛb bàwem Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ bàbilà anki mwo, ntɔn unkwɛɛm aba.
Kyakin, Nzam an'fàsà ilä asin ubeelà nde « ŋàbà ». Nde kàtɛn ntɔn kya ungöngö, u mbwo a David, unsà ndaa bàtäŋ kusà naa:

content.text: « Ŋàbà, isàkal naa bɛ lan'wem ndaa ande,

content: Abà, yàlàkal naa Yɔswa kàpɛ ngyöör akà un'sɛŋ, Nzam kàlàfàtɛn anki, ungö a indiir abi, ntɔn ilä asin.
Abun, yàlàfàsaal ngyöör mwɛy, ngyöör a saba ntɔn un'sɛŋ a Nzam.
Ntɔn mbuur awà kàbilà u ngyöör ande, nde sye wàmuyöör unsà isal ande, asànaa Nzam kàyöör nde unsà kyànde.
Abun, wɛy bi idüül mubilà u ngyöör ayi, ntɔn akà mbuur mwɛy ukɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà unsà unkwɛɛm asànaa baar a Isàlɛl.

Ntɔn ndaa a Nzam ye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, ya yà ngwal anà yan'söön kɔm lanswà u mpɔr. Ya ifàbilà tii kà ikal mukaab mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà dweelà, in'kwo anà usɔ. Nde afàsyeebà pànsi pànsi an'kyän a mpem a mbuur.
Akà ikyeer mwɛy ikwe anki mubaan kà ileer ande. Indiir byanswà byànsàpɔl anà byàŋàmɛɛy u mii a mbuur isàtääl bi in'lɔn.
Yɛsu, undweer a angaŋ a dudu
Kyakin, ntɔn bi ibye anà undweer a angaŋ a dudu awà kàlyaaŋ u du, Yɛsu, Mwan a Nzam, wɛy bi ikäär ubwaŋàbwaŋ làkwikilà ifàkyään bi.
Abun, bi ibye anà undweer a angaŋ kan'kwo mukiwem ngyɛb ntɔn gyɔ̈ɔ̈là abi. Nde bàkyer un'lwab ndaa amu indiir byanswà asànaa bi, wɛɛ nde man'be kàsàkyer anki.
Abun, wɛy bi isin anà kam anà làkyän tsütsü a kir a imwol a kab a ngway, ntɔn Nzam kiwem ngyɛb anà bi iwɛl kab a ngway kusà a nde ntɔn mukibay u taaŋ a taaŋ.
